messages:
anya: quick flag — ACME reported unexpected KMS decrypts for tenant acme-corp. Their audit copy has events but the 'actor' field is blank on several decrypts. Can we reconstruct who/what made those calls?

sanjay: :eyes: do we have cloud KMS admin logs + our forwarding pipeline? last time missing actor was a transform that stripped fields.

kevin: I pulled the forwarded events earlier. Looks like our ingestion schema v2 drops 'principalEmail' when metadata key 'opaque_actor' present. filing hypothesis.

liz: tagging infra-bot to surface recent deploys to the audit pipeline around the window: 2024-11-22T03:12:00Z - 2024-11-22T03:30:00Z

infra-bot: deploy triggered by kevin at 2024-11-22T03:15:47Z — pipeline version 2024.11.22-psi. No rollback.

anya: ok — if pipeline changed, we need the raw Cloud KMS audit logs (not just our forwarded JSON). Can someone pull gcp://projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity for that window?

kevin: running query now:
```
resource.type=\"kms_key\"
protoPayload.methodName:\"Decrypt\"
timestamp>=\"2024-11-22T03:10:00Z\" AND timestamp<=\"2024-11-22T03:40:00Z\"
```

kevin: quick sample from raw GCP audit (sanitized):
```
{\"protoPayload\": {\"methodName\": \"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\", \"authenticationInfo\": {\"principalEmail\": \"service-account-processor@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"}, \"request\": {...}}}
```

liz: that principalEmail maps to the batch transform service-account. matches our suspicion.

sanjay: so root cause = pipeline transform set opaque_actor flag and we dropped principalEmail in v2 schema. Can we confirm how many customer decrypt events lost actor?

kevin: counting now — ~23 decrypt events for acme-corp with blank actor in forwarded index; raw GCP shows actor present for all 23.

anya: good — remediation path: 1) fix ingestion v2 to preserve principalEmail even when opaque_actor present, 2) backfill forward index for those 23 events from raw logs, 3) notify customer with reconstructed timeline + assurance.

liz: on remediation: I have a small patch ready to ensure fields are preserved. I'll open PR and request quick review. tagging kevin for backfill script.

kevin: will write a backfill that re-ingests the raw protoPayload and merges principalEmail into forwarded events. script will run against archive bucket and write to audit-index. ETA 4h.

anya: also need to check RBAC changes — did any service-account role escalate recently? run iam.audit for the service-account in last 30d.

kevin: IAM audit shows no role changes for that SA in last 90d. Only key rotation.

anya: ok. final note for customer message: include the reconstructed entries showing timestamp, operation, and principalEmail. sample line to include (sanitized):
```
2024-11-22T03:18:04Z | Decrypt | service-account-processor@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com | key=projects/.../cryptoKeys/acme-key
```

liz: PR: github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pulls/1428 — fixes ingest schema to keep principalEmail. request review from @sanjay and @anya.

deploy-bot: pipeline deploy 2024.11.22-psi -> prod started at 2024-11-22T04:00:12Z (CI passed).

anya: thanks team. action items: liz PR merge (ASAP), kevin backfill and verification, send customer draft (I'll draft). I'll update incident tracker. :thumbsup:
